intent: Event form with audience picker, WIB display: create/edit/delete events, mixed user/role/group audience in one insert, times shown in WIB, recurring events expand from rrule.
summary: PSI-041 shipped the calendar view shell (month/week/day/agenda) and a read-only event detail dialog but no form: create/edit/delete and the audience picker did not exist. Added createEventAction and updateEventAction to calendar/actions.ts (Zod-validated; requirePermission('calendar.write') on create; RLS-backed creator+source='app' filter on update); both insert the full user/role/group audience in a single supabase.insert() call so the M4 event_audience_invites statement-level trigger fires once per save and notifies the whole audience together (existing DB behavior, no migration needed). getAudienceOptionsAction lists active profiles/roles/groups for the picker. Built EventFormDialog (plain form + FormData, matching this codebase's dialog convention) with a kind+select+Add audience picker (extends board-share-dialog.tsx's pattern to 3 kinds), an all-day toggle, and a Repeats select (none/daily/weekly/monthly) writing a bare RRULE string. Added calendar/lib/recurrence.ts (expandRecurringEvents, using the rrule package) wired into CalendarView so all 4 views render generated occurrences within a padded visible range; falls back to the single stored occurrence on a malformed rrule. Added calendar/lib/format.ts: WIB datetime-local <-> ISO conversion (fixed +07:00 offset, same convention as finance/lib/format.ts), WIB display formatters, and getWibHour for hour-of-day bucketing; replaced every toLocaleString/toLocaleTimeString call across the 4 view components with these. Wired Edit/Delete buttons into the event detail dialog (creator-only, app-only) and a header 'New event' button (calendar.write gated). Added rrule@2.8.1 as a dependency (RFC5545 expansion). 16 new unit tests plus all 64 pre-existing frontend tests still pass (80/80). tsc, oxlint, and `bun run build` all clean. See decisions[] for why plain forms over TanStack Form and +07:00 over @date-fns/tz.

changes.note: WIB datetime-local <-> ISO conversion, WIB display formatters, getWibHour
expandRecurringEvents: rrule-based occurrence expansion within a visible range
create/edit dialog with 3-kind audience picker, all-day toggle, recurrence select
recurrence expansion wiring, edit/delete buttons, WIB detail-dialog time display
WIB hour bucketing and time labels

decisions.reason: AGENTS.md documents useAppForm as the convention, but every existing dialog in this codebase (new-task-dialog.tsx, board-share-dialog.tsx, entry-form-dialog.tsx) actually uses plain forms. Followed what the code does, not the aspirational doc, for consistency.
alternatives: Introduce useAppForm for this one dialog, diverging from every sibling dialog

decisions.decision: wibInputValueToISO uses a fixed +07:00 offset, not @date-fns/tz's TZDate
decisions.reason: calendar.md suggested @date-fns/tz, but finance/lib/format.ts and src/agent/tools/get-agenda.ts already solve the same WIB problem with plain Date + explicit offset/timeZone option, and Indonesia has no DST so the fixed offset is exact. Matches the codebase's existing, working pattern instead of adding a second timezone library.

decisions.decision: Recurring occurrence ids are '<eventId>__<timestamp>'; edit/delete/board/finance actions resolve back to the base id by splitting on '__'
decisions.reason: The schema stores one starts_at per series; expanding occurrences client-side for display needs unique React keys without a second table. Editing or deleting always targets the whole series via the base id.

decisions.decision: Audience is replaced wholesale on edit (delete all + reinsert), not diffed
decisions.reason: M4 doc already states re-notifying the whole audience on an audience change is acceptable in v1; diffing would be more code for a behavior difference nobody asked for.

decisions.decision: Fixed WIB hour-of-day bucketing (getWibHour) in week/day views, but did NOT rework the day-grid's isSameDay (still browser-local calendar date)
decisions.reason: The accept criterion 'shown in Asia/Jakarta' is squarely about time labels/hour buckets, which I fixed. Reworking which day cell an event lands in near a WIB/browser-local midnight mismatch is a deeper, distinct change to the PSI-041 grid math; flagged as a follow-up rather than expanding this task's scope.
alternatives: Also rebuild month/week/day date-grid generation to bucket by WIB calendar day

verification.manual: No schema/migration touched, so db_reset/db_tests are n/a. `bun run build` succeeded (Next.js production build, all routes compiled including /dashboard/calendar). Did NOT do a live browser click-through (sign in, create an event with mixed audience, confirm WIB display, edit, delete): this app has no Playwright/E2E harness yet (PSI-036 is still backlog, blocked on PSI-031/032/035), so that verification is unit-test + build only, same substitution PSI-102's session used for its own blocked browser walkthrough.

dependencies_added.name: rrule
dependencies_added.reason: RFC5545 recurrence expansion for the accept criterion 'recurring events expand from rrule'; no existing dependency covers RRULE parsing/expansion and hand-rolling FREQ/BYDAY/UNTIL semantics would reinvent a well-tested spec library.

risks: Manual browser walkthrough not done this session (no E2E harness yet) — covered by 16 new unit tests + a clean production build instead.

Month/week/day grid day-bucketing still uses browser-local calendar date (pre-existing PSI-041 behavior), only the hour-of-day and all time labels are now WIB-explicit; a browser not set to WIB could still show an event under the wrong day cell near midnight.

follow_ups.note: Rework month/week/day view date-grid bucketing to use WIB calendar days instead of the browser's local calendar day (isSameDay currently compares browser-local Date fields). Low impact for WIB-based browsers (the expected audience), real for anyone outside WIB.

Browser walkthrough once an E2E harness exists (PSI-036): sign in as admin@p3md.test, create an event with a mixed user+role+group audience, confirm event.invited notifications land, edit it, verify WIB display end to end, delete it.
